text_blocks.snippet: The iris, the colored part of the eye, can be affected by various diseases and conditions. These can range from congenital abnormalities to acquired conditions, and some are associated with other systemic diseases. Common iris diseases include iris atrophy, heterochromia, and iritis.
Here's a more detailed look at some iris diseases:

list.title: Aniridia:
list.snippet: A rare genetic condition where the iris is partially or fully absent, potentially affecting other parts of the eye as well.

list.title: Heterochromia:
list.snippet: A condition where the irises of the eyes have different colors, or different sections of the same iris have different colors. It can be hereditary or caused by injury or disease.
